start.intro: Trade fours with a shadow of the band. Listen, answer, then play your own solo. Use D F J K or tap the four zones.
start.blocked: The browser did not start the sound. Press Try again to turn it on.
start.error: Something went wrong while starting the match.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The game hit an unexpected error. Your portfolio is unaffected.

unsupported.title: This browser cannot play the game
unsupported.body: The game needs Web Audio, which this browser does not offer. Try a recent version of Chrome, Firefox, Safari or Edge.

rotate.hint: Turn your phone sideways to play

lounge.name: Lounge
lounge.desc: Wide timing. Every target note is shown. Easy to play with the sound off.

session.name: Session
session.desc: Normal timing. Beat lines stay on, targets show only while the opponent plays.

lateSet.name: Late Set
lateSet.desc: Tight timing, swung rhythm. No targets and no beat lines: use your ears.

calibration.title: Tap along to the click
calibration.body: Tap the pad with each click. This measures the delay of your screen and headphones.
calibration.failTitle: We could not measure the delay
calibration.failBody: Too few taps landed close to the clicks. Delay is set to 0 ms.

pause.title: Paused
pause.body: When you resume there is one bar of count-in. This round restarts from the opponent's phrase and its score starts over.

lickBook.title: Lick book
lickBook.note: Round squares mark off-beat positions. Positions 1 to 8 read left to right.

assist.title: Want a little more room?
assist.body: Widen the timing windows by 15% for the rest of this run. The result screen will say so.
